Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Uoiei — Seating Plane — Provision is made for a shouldsr or other feature on the terminal to ensure that a 
minimum clearance Ai is maintained when the device Is inserted into holes not larger than the recommended 
maximum diameter of 0-8 mm in a printed board . 

Note 2 — The maximum material convention applies to the positional tolerance of the terminals. 

Note 3 — Dimension ei is given for mounting purposes only and corresponds to the zero value for angle 6, 

Note 4 — n refers to the total number of terminal positions. 

Note 5 — The overhang will be less than half pitch ( or one pitch as the case may be). 

Note 6 — Index mark indicates terminal /7°1. 

Note? — The contour of the terminals above the seating plane is optional (typical alternative terminal 
configurations are shown in the drawing ). but adequate clearance is made so that conductors on the mounting area 
can pass between the terminals. 

2. Rules for Coding — See 8.1 of IS : 5001 ( Part I )-1969.
